feeds.title: Consolidated Nurse Aide Training Institute Blog
feeds.description: Consolidated Nurse Aide Training Institute helps you train for CNA and secure a job in the healthcare industry. The Training Institute is dedicated to empowering individuals with the skills, knowledge, practical training, and experience needed for a successful career in the growing and rewarding fields of allied healthcare.

feeds.title: CNA Online Course Blog
feeds.description: This blog centers on everything you need to become a Certified Nurse Assistant. Learn about jobs, the certification exam, inspiring stories, tips, schools, etc. Start your nursing career today as a CNA!

feeds.title: The National Association of Health Care Assistants Blog
feeds.description: NAHCA's mission is to elevate the professional standing and performance of a CNA and other caregivers through recognition, advocacy, education, and empowerment while building a strong alliance with health care providers to maximize success and quality patient care.

feeds.title: CNA Programs Blog
feeds.description: We are dedicated to providing all the latest information on how to become a Certified Nursing Assistant or CNA. Here, you will find everything you need to help you decide if becoming a CNA is the right career choice for you and detailed information about the steps to becoming a CNA, from finding the right program to what's next after school.

feeds.title: Serenity Nurse Aide Academy Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about what we do and the healthcare industry. Serenity is committed to excellence in education. Our mission is to provide affordable quality training using the latest and most innovative resources to help you reach your personal goals as successful CNAs.

feeds.title: 4YourCNA Blog
feeds.description: 4YourCNA provides online CNA Test Prep and classroom training. Our mission is to provide high-quality, low-cost medical vocational training for entry-level healthcare employees to ensure proper comprehension of patient care skills and theory for maximum application in a clinical setting.

feeds.title: CNA Test Prep Blog
feeds.description: Everything you need to know about CNA is brought to you in one place by CNA Test Prep Blog. Read articles on interview tips, exam preparation, things you need to know, and more. CNA Test Prep is a free browser/web platform that gives test-takers a unique CNA training service.

feeds.title: JJ School of Technology Blog
feeds.description: Read our educational blogs today to learn more about JJST's healthcare training programs. JJ School of Technology is a CNA School in Brooklyn Park, Minnesota.

feeds.title: CNALicense.org Blog
feeds.description: Whether you are looking for information about the average CNA salary, the best states to work as a CNA, or how to prepare for the CNA certification exam, you will find the answers to your questions right here! CNALicense.org is your one-stop source for information on Nursing Assistant licensure.
